notes.title: Update 2.59 - August 18th
notes.content:
Hi,

Thanks for all the comments on the Community Hub, we have been paying close attention and now we have another update!

Release Notes

Resolved startup issues
Introduce physics performance setting under options
Fixed drag start lights / timing not being meaningful
Minor performance improvements
Removed "Remove Ads" UI
Minor UI bugs fixed


- James

notes.title: Bug Fix Update - July 23rd - Controls Fixes and Match Making Multiplayer!
notes.content:
PATCH NOTES

Enabled access to multiplayer beta, please note, THIS IS MATCH MAKING ONLY
AI difficulty overhaul, remove AI start boost and fixed some racing lines
Mouse input fixed in Windows verison
Improved steering for keyboard & controllers
Acceleration properly mapped to triggers on controllers
Braking & reverse properly mapped to triggers on controllers
Added better support for steering wheels
Removed controller & graphics setup at startup and replaced with graphics options in menu
Added ability to control mouse cursor with right analog stick


Controller Support List
The following describes the current state of support controllers, please contact us with your controller brand and model if it does not work so we may try to include it in future updates.

Supported & Tested:

Xbox Wired (OSX & Windows)
Logitech Gamepad F310
Thrustmaster FGT Rumble 3-in-1 Wheel
Logitech Driving Force GT

Supported:

Executioner X on Windows and Mac.
GameStick on itself and on Linux.
Hama Black Force on Windows.
Logitech F510 on Windows, Mac and Linux.
Logitech F710 on Windows, Mac and Linux.
Logitech WingMan on Windows.
MaxFire Blaze5 on Windows.
Moga Pro on Windows, Mac and Linux.
Natec Genesis P44 on Windows.
NVIDIA Shield on Windows.
PlayStation 2 controller on Windows (with adapter)
PlayStation 3 controller on Windows, Mac and Linux.
PlayStation 4 controller on Windows, Mac, Linux.
Speedlink Strike on Windows and Mac.
SteelSeries Free on Windows, Mac and Linux.
Valve Streaming Gamepad on Windows.
Xbox 360 controller on Windows, Mac, Linux.
Xbox One controller on Windows and Mac.
A variety of Xbox 360 clones are supported.

Unsupported but may work:

Logitech G25 Wheel
Logitech G27 Wheel
